signals.title: Europese Commissie wil MiCA uitbreiden voor tokenisering en niet-EU stablecoin-emittenten
signals.summary: The European Commission is reportedly seeking comment from stakeholders on expanding MiCA rules until Sept. 30.

signals.title: ECB en EU centrale banken willen MiCA-depositorequirements voor stablecoins aanpassen
signals.summary: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s stablecoin bank-deposit requirements with liquidity thresholds, warning that sudden withdrawals could strain lenders.

signals.title: EBA publiceert ontwerpmethodologie voor boeterollen onder MiCA
signals.summary: ​The European Banking Authority (EBA) published today a Consultation Paper with a draft methodology for setting fines in its role as supervisor under MiCA. The objective is to ensure that fines imposed on issuers of significant crypto-assets are consistent, proportionate and transparent, and effectively support compliance with the regulatory framework.

signals.title: Thailand stelt dagelijkse limiet van 148.000 dollar voor stablecoin-transacties voor.
signals.summary: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

signals.title: Griffin haalt $20 miljoen op voor stablecoin en betalingsservices
signals.summary: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.

signals.title: BitGo breidt USDC-minting- en inlossingsdiensten voor institutionele klanten uit
signals.summary: BitGo's institutional clients can now mint and redeem USDC through Go Accounts, with orders handled through its Circle Mint account.

signals.title: Britse bank Griffin haalt 20 miljoen dollar op voor stablecoin-betalingen
signals.summary: UK bank Griffin raises $20 million to expand into stablecoin payments

signals.title: Stablecoinaanbod daalt 14,2 miljard dollar in grootste maandverlies sinds juni 2022
signals.summary: Crypto markets were left with “less fuel” to rally after the market cap of major stablecoins saw its biggest 30-day drop in over four years.
